edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the initial owner inside the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the ownership handover.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without any additional authorization.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and thus depends on the caller identity.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callback.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor assigns symbol = "EAG8".
Constructor assigns name = "AtromG8".
Constructor assigns decimals = 8.
Constructor sets _totalSupply = 500000000000000.
Constructor pre-mints the whole supply to a hard-coded address in balances.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] with raw unsigned subtraction.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the burned amount in an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
approve writes the nested allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer delegates balance debits to safeSub.
transfer delegates balance credits to safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeAdd for balances[to].
transfer performs unsigned arithmetic on token balances.
transferFrom performs unsigned arithmetic on balances and allowance.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract at a caller-supplied spender address before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards tokens to the stored owner address.
The external call reaches the receiveApproval implementation of the spender contract.
A malicious spender may re-enter approveAndCall or transfer while the external callback is executing.
The spender parameter is the arbitrary target address of the external receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the external callback before state is finalized.
